entries.cabacfecffb3d58f: Under its long-term vision, the company aims to address the materiality issues (key issues) it has identified in light of risks and opportunities arising from changes in the business environment, and to achieve sustainable growth and medium- to long-term enhancement of corporate value. As growth strategies, it cites organic growth that strengthens existing businesses (developing new sales destinations, offering new products, expanding its branch network, and diversifying sales methods and services such as construction and rental), expansion into overseas markets and strengthening of adjacent fields through the use of digital technology, and M&A to accelerate both of these. To strengthen its management foundation, it is advancing the use of digital technology to raise productivity and the strengthening of human capital.
